name: B10-0081/2026 (PPE) – Brutal repression against protesters in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Iran's violent crackdown on protests that began in late December 2025. It calls for an end to the killing of protesters, the release of detained demonstrators and political prisoners, and the lifting of the internet blackout. It asks the European Union to sanction those responsible, to label Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps as a terrorist organisation, and to support a democratic transition in Iran. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and demands; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament demands Iran stop the violence, free detainees and restore internet access.
- It asks the European Union to sanction Iranian officials and ban the Revolutionary Guard Corps.
- European Union governments and the European Commission are urged to act on these demands.
